posts.title: Initialization Profile Probes
posts.description: These are the probes that go with the review of P4222R3's examples : small programs that ask what the two implementations of the initialization profile do with shapes the paper does not show. The compilers and flags are the ones described there, -std=c++23 -pedantic-errors , with the profile turned on by the attribute at the top of the file. Read more… (6 min remaining to read)

posts.description: "Standardize existing practice" was barely true of the first C++ standard, and it is the wrong rule now. It was already being stretched in 1998. The ARM was existing practice.
